mostWorthwhile.text: The calcium-triggered sliding-filament sequence was most worthwhile: the planned poses distinguish shortening the fibre from shortening the filaments, while showing ATP's role in the cycle.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the two muscles in separate, similar combinations felt somewhat repetitive, although their different heads and attachments gave the results useful distinctions.

surprise.text: The relaxation result was a useful reminder that ATP powers calcium's return to storage and that an outside pull lengthens the fibre.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though choosing which muscle to build or attach first was largely a matter of order rather than a meaningful distinction.

continue.text: I would continue: connecting the microscopic pulling mechanism to opposing elbow movements was interesting, although the mostly single-option sequence left limited room for decisions.
